written_by: Claude Code, for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Psychology for Explore (spec 21), batch 2. Every name and description is in Stackd's own words; nothing is copied from UC's page. C-ID numbers, the template number and revision, the degree name, the unit totals and the campus major names are copied exactly. UC pathway: the Psychology Transfer Pathway page on admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (it states no term or year; academic_year is the year it was checked). TMC: template #1002, the PDF in source_url. An option with no C-ID number has an empty c_id, which needs the migration 20261031120000_explore_option_no_c_id.sql before this file can be imported. Topics in both pathways (Counts for both): statistics, psych-intro. UC's biology (the first course of the STEM series) isn't shared with the template's biology-based list, which accepts non-majors biology. Research methods is Cal State only. Calculus, the extra science and the social science courses are UC only. Check every row against its source, delete each todo once confirmed, fill in retrieved_at on both pathways, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/explore/psychology.json --dry-run
